Their background is predominantly in full-stack web development, DevOps tooling, and open-source GIS platforms, with no evidence of hardware-software co-design, GPU architecture, or performance modeling for AI accelerators.

Proven track record in open-source contributions and technical education
Demonstrated ability to work with low-latency systems and performance-critical code (e.g., DLang)
concerns: No demonstrated experience with SoC, IP, or AI accelerator modeling
Lacks background in deep learning workload optimization or GPU architecture
